Basic.job: Pick one task you repeat every week, list two ways to simplify it, try one and note the time saved.
Basic.coaching: Discuss with your coach one improvement idea you hesitated to raise, and plan how to propose it.
Basic.learning: Module 3 session on innovation and problem solving; apply one idea-generation technique to a live task.

Proficient.job: Lead a small improvement in your team's process: compare at least two options, pilot one for a month and measure the result.
Proficient.coaching: Review the pilot results with your coach, including what you would change and how you handled resistance.
Proficient.learning: Module 3 innovation and problem-solving content; use the business challenge to test a new approach.

Advanced.job: Sponsor a cross-department pilot linked to an SDC priority, with agreed success measures and a decision point to scale or stop.
Advanced.coaching: Work with your coach on building support for experimentation among senior stakeholders.
Advanced.learning: Module 3 strategy and innovation sessions and the capstone project; share lessons with other departments.

Basic.job: Agree three clear outcomes for the next quarter with your manager, track them weekly and flag any risk early.
Basic.coaching: Review your weekly tracking with your coach and identify what most often delays your delivery.
Basic.learning: Apply Module 3 business acumen to translate business priorities into measurable quarterly outcomes, using Module 1 goal-setting techniques to track progress.

Proficient.job: Own a team deliverable with competing priorities; set milestones, track progress and adjust the plan when obstacles appear.
Proficient.coaching: Use coaching to work through one trade-off between priorities and how you communicated it.
Proficient.learning: Module 3 business acumen and decision-making sessions; apply one prioritisation tool to the deliverable.

Advanced.job: Set a stretching outcome for a cross-team initiative, align resources around it and report progress to senior management monthly.
Advanced.coaching: Discuss with your coach how you sustain performance when conditions change mid-delivery.
Advanced.learning: Module 3 and the capstone business project; present results and lessons in the C-suite presentation.

Basic.job: In your next three meetings, summarise what others said before giving your view, and share notes with colleagues afterwards.
Basic.coaching: Ask your coach for feedback on how clearly you communicate in writing, using two recent emails.
Basic.learning: Module 2 communication and collaboration sessions; practise active listening in the workplace application.

Proficient.job: Lead a joint task with another team: agree roles, hold regular check-ins and resolve one disagreement directly.
Proficient.coaching: Prepare with your coach for a conversation with a stakeholder who sees the work differently.
Proficient.learning: Module 2 sessions on influence, feedback and collaboration; apply them to the team-based challenge.

Advanced.job: Bring together stakeholders from several functions around a shared outcome, and run the forum that keeps them aligned.
Advanced.coaching: Use coaching to map key stakeholders and plan how to build trust where relationships are weak.
Advanced.learning: Apply Module 2 influence and collaboration techniques, supported by Module 4 stakeholder management, during the capstone project. Document stakeholder alignment and agreed outcomes.

Basic.job: Review the policies that apply to your role with your manager and confirm how you handle confidential information.
Basic.coaching: Discuss with your coach a time you made a mistake, how you acknowledged it and what you learned.
Basic.learning: Module 1 sessions on personal accountability and leadership standards.

Proficient.job: When you see a practice that conflicts with policy or values, raise it constructively with the right person and record the outcome.
Proficient.coaching: Work through a real ethical dilemma from your role with your coach, weighing the competing interests.
Proficient.learning: Module 1 leadership standards content; review SDC's code of conduct and its practical cases.

Advanced.job: Act as the integrity reference point on a sensitive initiative, setting clear standards and holding others to them.
Advanced.coaching: Use coaching to prepare for addressing a complex ethical issue with senior stakeholders.
Advanced.learning: Apply Module 1 leadership standards, reinforced by Module 4 executive presence. Demonstrate ethical judgement through a workplace situation and document the decision and rationale.

Basic.job: Keep a commitment log for one month: what you promised, when, and whether it was delivered; tell people early about any slip.
Basic.coaching: Review the log with your coach and agree one habit that improves follow-through.
Basic.learning: Module 1 sessions on personal accountability and leadership mindset.

Proficient.job: Take end-to-end ownership of one improvement, including follow-through after launch and correcting what does not work.
Proficient.coaching: Use coaching to plan the difficult conversations needed when commitments are at risk.
Proficient.learning: Module 1 accountability content; apply it to your stretch assignment.

Advanced.job: Define clear ownership for every outcome in a team or project, and review accountability openly at each milestone.
Advanced.coaching: Discuss with your coach how to hold others to account while keeping trust.
Advanced.learning: Apply Module 1 accountability principles, supported by Module 2 team leadership. Take ownership of a defined team deliverable and demonstrate follow-through against agreed commitments.

Basic.job: Read SDC's strategy and explain to your manager how your work contributes to two of its priorities.
Basic.coaching: Discuss with your coach one decision where you considered the wider context, and what you would do differently.
Basic.learning: Module 3 strategy session and its pre-reading.

Proficient.job: Lead a short horizon-scan of external trends affecting your area and present the implications to your department head.
Proficient.coaching: Pair with a senior sponsor to test the assumptions behind your department's plan.
Proficient.learning: Module 3 strategy content and the business simulation.

Advanced.job: Shape a two-to-three-year direction for your function, testing assumptions with scenarios and aligning stakeholders behind it.
Advanced.coaching: Use coaching to prepare how you will present and defend a long-term view to the executive team.
Advanced.learning: Module 3 strategy content and the capstone project with its C-suite presentation.

Basic.job: Hold a monthly check-in with your team on commitments and standards, and remove one obstacle each month.
Basic.coaching: Review with your coach how you balance short-term delivery with your team's workload.

Proficient.job: Set clear performance expectations for your team, review them with data each month and adjust resources where needed.
Proficient.coaching: Discuss with your coach a trade-off between short-term results and team capability, and how you decided.
Proficient.learning: Module 2 performance and feedback content; Module 3 business acumen sessions.

Advanced.job: Design a system that sustains performance in your area, such as a capability plan or a performance rhythm, and track its effect.
Advanced.coaching: Use coaching to plan deliberate trade-offs between results, people and risk.
Advanced.learning: Apply Module 2 performance management and coaching, supported by Module 3 business performance concepts and Module 4 succession readiness. Develop a measurable team performance improvement plan.

Basic.job: For your next three decisions, write down the information used, the options considered and a simple action plan.
Basic.coaching: Review one of these decisions with your coach after it plays out.
Basic.learning: Module 3 decision-making session; apply one decision tool to a live choice.

Proficient.job: Lead a decision that involves other stakeholders: evaluate alternatives and risks, decide on time and adjust the plan as conditions change.
Proficient.coaching: Use coaching to review how you balanced speed and evidence in that decision.
Proficient.learning: Module 3 decision-making and problem-solving content and the business simulation.

Advanced.job: Lead a high-impact decision under uncertainty, with a plan that sets priorities, contingencies and clear accountabilities.
Advanced.coaching: Discuss with your coach how you integrate conflicting views before deciding.
Advanced.learning: Module 3 decision-making content and the capstone project.

Basic.job: Recognise one specific contribution from a colleague each week, and explain how it helped the team's goal.
Basic.coaching: Discuss with your coach what motivates the people you work with most closely.
Basic.learning: Module 2 sessions on team leadership and feedback.

Proficient.job: In each team meeting, link current work to the team's purpose, and hold a development conversation with each team member this quarter.
Proficient.coaching: Use coaching to plan how to keep engagement up through a demanding period.
Proficient.learning: Module 2 coaching and motivation content; apply it in the team-based challenge.

Advanced.job: Lead your team or project through a significant change, communicating purpose and adapting your approach to different people's needs.
Advanced.coaching: Work with your coach on how you build confidence when the path is uncertain.
Advanced.learning: Apply Module 2 coaching and motivation techniques, reinforced by Module 4 change management. Lead a team engagement activity and gather feedback on its impact.

Basic.job: Choose two behaviours you expect of others and ask a trusted colleague to tell you monthly whether you show them consistently.
Basic.coaching: Review that feedback with your coach and agree one change.
Basic.learning: Apply Module 4 executive presence and role-modelling, building on Module 1 leadership standards. Demonstrate consistent professional behaviours and seek feedback on their impact.

Proficient.job: Under pressure, model the standards you set: note one difficult moment each week and how your conduct reinforced them.
Proficient.coaching: Use coaching to reflect on composure under pressure and how others read your behaviour.
Proficient.learning: Apply Module 4 executive presence, supported by Module 1 emotional intelligence and Module 2 team leadership. Model expected behaviours during a team challenge and document feedback.

Advanced.job: Take visible responsibility for a difficult leadership decision, explain it openly and model the values it reflects.
Advanced.coaching: Discuss with your coach how your conduct sets the tone across the organisation.
Advanced.learning: Module 4 executive presence content and the capstone presentation.

Proficient.smart: By day 90, pilot one improvement to a team process, chosen from at least two options, and show a measured gain in time, cost or quality.
Proficient.day30: Current process mapped; two improvement options compared and one agreed with the line manager.
Proficient.day60: Pilot running for at least four weeks, with a baseline and weekly measures.
Proficient.day90: Results reported to the team, with a decision to keep, change or stop the improvement.
Proficient.evidence: Pilot plan and before/after measures; written decision on next steps; line manager feedback on the result.

Advanced.smart: By day 90, launch a cross-department pilot linked to an SDC priority, with agreed success measures and a scale-or-stop decision date.
Advanced.day30: SDC priority and partner departments confirmed; success measures agreed with the sponsor.
Advanced.day60: Pilot live in at least two departments; mid-point review held with stakeholders.
Advanced.day90: Scale-or-stop recommendation presented to senior management.
Advanced.evidence: Pilot charter with success measures; mid-point review notes; senior management decision on the recommendation.

Proficient.smart: By day 90, deliver one team deliverable on time and to the agreed standard, with milestones tracked weekly and slippage flagged within one week.
Proficient.day30: Deliverable, standard and milestones agreed with the line manager; weekly tracker in use.
Proficient.day60: At least half the milestones met on time; any slippage raised with a recovery plan.
Proficient.day90: Deliverable completed and reviewed against the agreed standard.
Proficient.evidence: Milestone tracker; completed deliverable; line manager's written assessment against the standard.

Advanced.smart: By day 90, lead a cross-team initiative to a stretching, measurable outcome, reporting progress to senior management every month.
Advanced.day30: Outcome and measures agreed with the sponsor; resources and owners assigned across teams.
Advanced.day60: First two monthly progress reports issued; at least one course correction documented.
Advanced.day90: Outcome achieved or a documented recovery plan approved by the sponsor.
Advanced.evidence: Monthly progress reports; documented course corrections; sponsor feedback on the outcome achieved.

Proficient.smart: By day 90, complete a joint task with another team with roles agreed in writing, fortnightly check-ins and at least one disagreement resolved directly.
Proficient.day30: Joint task, roles and check-in rhythm agreed with the other team in writing.
Proficient.day60: At least three check-ins held; one disagreement raised and resolved, with the outcome recorded.
Proficient.day90: Joint task delivered; both teams give feedback on the collaboration.
Proficient.evidence: Written role agreement; check-in notes; feedback from the other team's lead and the line manager.

Advanced.smart: By day 90, set up and chair a cross-functional forum around a shared outcome, with agreed actions tracked between meetings.
Advanced.day30: Stakeholder map completed; forum purpose and members agreed with the sponsor.
Advanced.day60: At least two forum meetings held, with actions and owners recorded.
Advanced.day90: Shared outcome progressed as agreed; members rate the forum's usefulness.
Advanced.evidence: Stakeholder map; forum action log; stakeholder feedback collected at day 90.

Proficient.smart: By day 90, raise at least one practice that conflicts with policy or values through the right channel, and record the outcome.
Proficient.day30: Policies and code of conduct relevant to the role reviewed with the line manager.
Proficient.day60: One real dilemma worked through with the coach, with the reasoning written down.
Proficient.day90: Issue raised constructively through the right channel; outcome recorded.
Proficient.evidence: Written dilemma analysis; record of the issue raised and its outcome; line manager feedback on how it was handled.

Advanced.smart: By day 90, set and communicate clear integrity standards for one sensitive initiative and review compliance with them at each milestone.
Advanced.day30: Standards for the initiative written and agreed with the sponsor.
Advanced.day60: Standards communicated to everyone involved; first compliance review held.
Advanced.day90: Second review completed; any breaches addressed and lessons shared.
Advanced.evidence: Written standards; compliance review notes; sponsor feedback on how issues were handled.

Proficient.smart: By day 90, own one improvement end to end, including follow-through after launch and correction of anything that does not work.
Proficient.day30: Improvement scope, owner role and success measures agreed with the line manager.
Proficient.day60: Improvement launched; first follow-up review completed.
Proficient.day90: Issues found after launch corrected; results reported.
Proficient.evidence: Improvement plan and measures; follow-up review notes; line manager feedback on ownership and follow-through.

Advanced.smart: By day 90, assign a named owner to every outcome in a team or project and review accountability openly at each milestone.
Advanced.day30: Ownership map for all outcomes agreed with the team.
Advanced.day60: First accountability review held; slipped commitments addressed directly.
Advanced.day90: Second review held; on-time delivery compared with the start.
Advanced.evidence: Ownership map; accountability review notes; team and sponsor feedback.

Basic.smart: By day 90, explain in writing how your work contributes to two SDC strategic priorities, and adjust one piece of work to fit them better.
Basic.day30: SDC strategy read and discussed with the line manager.
Basic.day60: One-page note linking your work to two priorities, reviewed with the coach.
Basic.day90: One piece of work adjusted, and the change explained to the line manager.
Basic.evidence: One-page note; the adjusted piece of work; line manager feedback on the link to strategy.

Proficient.smart: By day 90, complete a horizon scan of external trends affecting your area and present the implications to your department head.
Proficient.day30: Scope of the scan and its sources agreed with the department head.
Proficient.day60: Trends analysed and implications drafted; assumptions tested with a senior sponsor.
Proficient.day90: Findings presented; at least one implication taken into the department plan.
Proficient.evidence: Horizon-scan report; presentation; department head's decision on the recommendations.

Advanced.smart: By day 90, draft a two-to-three-year direction for your function, tested with scenarios and reviewed by the executive team.
Advanced.day30: Key assumptions and scenarios defined with the coach and a sponsor.
Advanced.day60: Draft direction shared with the main stakeholders and their input recorded.
Advanced.day90: Direction presented to the executive team and their decision recorded.
Advanced.evidence: Scenario analysis; draft direction paper; executive team feedback and decision.

Basic.smart: By day 90, hold a monthly check-in with your team on commitments and standards, and remove at least one obstacle each month.
Basic.day30: First check-in held; commitments and standards written down.
Basic.day60: Second check-in held; two obstacles removed and recorded.
Basic.day90: Third check-in held; team feedback gathered on workload and support.
Basic.evidence: Check-in notes; log of obstacles removed; team feedback.

Proficient.smart: By day 90, set written performance expectations for your team and review them with data every month, adjusting resources where needed.
Proficient.day30: Expectations and measures written and agreed with each team member.
Proficient.day60: First monthly data review held; at least one resource adjustment made.
Proficient.day90: Second review held; changes in team performance reported.
Proficient.evidence: Written expectations; monthly performance data; line manager feedback on the team's results.

Advanced.smart: By day 90, put in place one system that sustains performance in your area, such as a capability plan or performance rhythm, and track its effect.
Advanced.day30: Performance risk identified and the system designed with the sponsor.
Advanced.day60: System in use; first measures collected.
Advanced.day90: Effect reviewed and reported, with the trade-offs made documented.
Advanced.evidence: System design; performance measures before and after; sponsor feedback.

Basic.smart: By day 90, document your next three decisions (information used, options considered, action plan) and review the outcome of each.
Basic.day30: First decision documented using a simple template.
Basic.day60: Second and third decisions documented; first one reviewed after it played out.
Basic.day90: All three reviewed with the coach; one lesson applied.
Basic.evidence: Three decision records; post-decision reviews; line manager feedback on decision quality.

Proficient.smart: By day 90, lead one decision involving other stakeholders, with alternatives and risks evaluated in writing and the decision made by the agreed date.
Proficient.day30: Decision, deadline and stakeholders agreed with the line manager.
Proficient.day60: Options and risks analysed in writing; stakeholders consulted.
Proficient.day90: Decision made on time; the plan adjusted as conditions changed, and the result reviewed.
Proficient.evidence: Decision paper with options and risks; record of stakeholder input; line manager feedback on the decision and its timing.

Advanced.smart: By day 90, lead a high-impact decision under uncertainty with a written plan setting priorities, contingencies and accountabilities.
Advanced.day30: Decision framed with the sponsor; conflicting views gathered.
Advanced.day60: Decision made and the plan issued with contingencies and owners.
Advanced.day90: First results reviewed; contingencies used or adjusted as needed.
Advanced.evidence: Decision paper; implementation plan; sponsor review of the outcome.

Basic.smart: By day 90, give specific recognition at least once a week, each time linking the contribution to a team goal.
Basic.day30: Recognition habit started; motivators of close colleagues discussed with the coach.
Basic.day60: At least eight recognitions given and noted.
Basic.day90: Feedback gathered from colleagues on the effect.
Basic.evidence: Recognition log; colleague feedback; coach review.

Proficient.smart: By day 90, hold a development conversation with every team member and link current work to the team's purpose in each team meeting.
Proficient.day30: Development conversations scheduled; team purpose agreed and written down.
Proficient.day60: At least half the conversations held, each with an agreed action.
Proficient.day90: All conversations held; team engagement check completed.
Proficient.evidence: Record of conversations and agreed actions; short team engagement check; line manager feedback.

Advanced.smart: By day 90, lead your team or project through a significant change with a written communication plan and two engagement checks.
Advanced.day30: Change and its purpose defined; communication plan written.
Advanced.day60: Change under way; first engagement check done and concerns addressed.
Advanced.day90: Change milestones met; second engagement check compared with the first.
Advanced.evidence: Communication plan; two engagement checks; sponsor feedback on how the change was led.

Basic.smart: By day 90, choose two behaviours you expect of others and get monthly feedback from a trusted colleague on whether you show them consistently.
Basic.day30: Two behaviours chosen; colleague agreed to give feedback.
Basic.day60: Two rounds of feedback received; one change agreed with the coach.
Basic.day90: Third round of feedback shows the change in place.
Basic.evidence: Monthly feedback notes; agreed change; colleague and line manager feedback.

Proficient.smart: By day 90, keep a weekly record of one high-pressure moment and how your conduct reinforced the standards you set, and seek team feedback.
Proficient.day30: Standards written down; weekly record started.
Proficient.day60: Record reviewed with the coach; one pattern identified and addressed.
Proficient.day90: Team feedback gathered on consistency under pressure.
Proficient.evidence: Weekly record; coach review notes; team feedback.

Advanced.smart: By day 90, take visible responsibility for one difficult leadership decision, explaining it openly and showing the values it reflects.
Advanced.day30: Decision identified and the communication approach planned with the coach.
Advanced.day60: Decision communicated openly; questions and concerns answered.
Advanced.day90: Follow-up held on the decision's effect; lessons shared with peers.
Advanced.evidence: Communication record; follow-up notes; senior stakeholder feedback.
